reuse_policy: Original checklists only. No guide text is bundled. The upstream educational-purpose notice is not treated as a broad redistribution grant.

reviewed_sections: Core Concepts / Types of Tender Error
Process & Methodology / Step 2: Qualifications and Exclusions Review
checklists.retained_methods: Check arithmetic, compare stated scope, investigate pricing patterns and show the effect of supported comparison scenarios.
checklists.excluded_defaults: No automatic tender-price correction, assumption that blank prices are zero, invented adjustment cost, inference of misconduct from a low rate, UK procurement rule or scoring weight. The adopted tender procedure controls formal corrections.

checklists.retained_methods: Identify the event and cost driver, record the basis of a scenario, check overlapping allowances and track mitigation ownership.
checklists.excluded_defaults: No example contingency percentage, UK cost, assumed likelihood, automatic ground-risk transfer or unsupported probabilistic confidence. Actual contract documents determine risk allocation.

reviewed_sections: Process & Methodology / Step 2: Select Appropriate Comparators
Process & Methodology / Step 3: Collect and Organise Data
Process & Methodology / Step 4: Analyse and Compare
Process & Methodology / Step 5: Interpret and Report
checklists.retained_methods: Record the original rate basis, select comparable records, explain adjustments and investigate differences before drawing a conclusion.
checklists.excluded_defaults: No automatic UK index, wage, tax, location factor, percentage tolerance or statistical rejection cut-off. A source must fit the Hong Kong component, billing denominator and dates.

limits: The review covers the named sections and methods only. It does not adopt the wider guide as a runtime instruction source, project evidence or governing contract. NEC deadlines and deemed acceptance require the actual adopted clauses and amendments. The bundled checklists work without upstream repository access.
